status: Additional analysis control specified while the perturbation runs were still executing, before inspecting their outcomes.
reason: Agreement of perturbed velocity fields normalized by the large baseline can hide errors in a tiny perturbation response.
measure: Compare delta-u = u-perturbed minus u-baseline between grids, normalized by the fine-grid delta-u L2 norm, alongside relative amplification-factor difference.
screen: Both relative errors below1%, plus unbroken local validity screens in both baselines and both perturbations. Same tolerance scale as the original full-velocity spatial screen. Descriptive only, not a rigorous error bound.
selection: Every available matching amplitude and seed on neighboring grids; no favorable selection. This does not change any simulated trajectory.
